label: The local mcp-figma contract makes Framelink MCP an optional read-context path into the agent and keeps Figma Desktop CLI as the primary author, modify, and export surface. The documented MCP route therefore cannot create FigJam by itself; a FigJam-only workflow needs the CLI FigJam surface as its board-writing step. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/mcp-wiring.md:32] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/SKILL.md:42]

The local wiring notes identify two live-confirmed Framelink tools: figma_get_figma_data and figma_download_figma_images. The tool names and schemas are not pinned; the manual warns to discover the registered tool list and call schema before use because the package is @latest. The cited live discovery is dated 2026-06-14, so this run does not treat it as current runtime verification. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/mcp-wiring.md:95] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/mcp-wiring.md:112]

The FigJam CLI namespace separates read operations (fj list, info, nodes) from write operations (sticky, shape, text, connect, move, update); fj delete is destructive and fj eval is arbitrary execution. This gives a documented FigJam-native output surface while keeping the risk class visible per operation. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/tool-surface.md:149]

The FigJam-writing route inherits Desktop and version dependencies: the skill says the CLI needs Figma Desktop installed and open, and its complete command surface requires figma-ds-cli 1.2.0 from the silships repository because npm only publishes a minimal 1.0.0 build. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/SKILL.md:18] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/SKILL.md:54]

The local Figma skill requires confirmation, an explicit target, and a rollback note before FigJam write verbs; destructive actions and arbitrary evaluation have stricter explicit-request rules. Product Owner should therefore separate source interpretation from board mutation and define how a user authorizes the target board before any generated output is written.
